rows.grounds: epithet indicating sudden or immediate arising
past participle indicating realization or attainment
demonstrative pronoun referring to the goddess
compound denoting the leading goddess of the circle

items.question: What identity is claimed for Kubjikā as the mistress of the circle?
premises: Kubjikā is identified as the mistress of the circle.
items.inference: Kubjikā is the immediately-born, accomplished mistress of the circle.
uncertainties: The specific sense of sadyojātaḥ in this context may be technical or ritual.
items.plain_english: She, Kubjikā, immediately arisen and accomplished, is the mistress of the circle.
